title: FAQ section with FAQPage structured data
when: The user wants a FAQ block on a page, with collapsible answers and structured data for search results.
prompt:
Goal: A scannable FAQ with native disclosure answers and FAQPage JSON-LD that matches the visible text exactly.
Steps:
1. <section aria-labelledby="faq-title"> with an h2; each item is <details> with <summary> holding the question.
2. Pick 6 to 10 questions people really ask about price, delivery, cancellation and support; write the question as they would say it.
3. Answers are one to three sentences, with a link when there is more detail.
4. Add <script type="application/ld+json"> with @type FAQPage and mainEntity of Question items, each with name and acceptedAnswer of type Answer with text.
5. Copy the visible text into the JSON-LD and escape double quotes.
Quality bar:
- Questions are grouped or ordered by importance.
- Answers start with the direct answer.
- Summary rows have a visible focus style.
Pitfalls:
- JSON-LD with questions not shown on the page.
- Marketing copy disguised as questions.
- Trailing commas that break the JSON.
Verify:
- [ ] Each question is a summary.
- [ ] The JSON-LD parses.
- [ ] JSON-LD text matches the page.
- [ ] No filler answers.
Output: The FAQ section and its JSON-LD in the page, styles in style.css.

examples.input: perguntas frequentes sobre entrega e trocas
examples.output: details list with 8 questions, short answers with links, FAQPage JSON-LD mirroring the text
